custom_logic_notes: X2 variant requires both timeframe 1 and timeframe 2 CG Oscillator signals to align for entry. The EA uses a standard CExpert-based pattern from MQL5 Standard Library with CSignalCGOscillator_X2 custom signal module. Entry requires crossover on TF1 AND confirmation from TF2 direction. The CG (Center of Gravity) Oscillator is a custom indicator based on John Ehlers' Center of Gravity oscillator - it is not built into MT5 and must be compiled separately. Opposite signal on TF1 triggers close+reverse if both TFs confirm.
external_dependencies: CGOscillator.ex5 (custom indicator required for iCustom calls)
SignalCGOscillator_X2.mqh (custom signal module for CExpert framework)
MoneyFixedLot.mqh or similar CMoney class from MQL5 Standard Library
python_conversion_notes: The CG Oscillator must be reimplemented in Python from Ehlers' algorithm: CG = -Sum(price[i] * (i+1), period) / Sum(price[i], period) + (period+1)/2 normalized. The X2 dual-timeframe confirmation logic needs careful implementation - both the crossover on the primary timeframe AND the directional agreement on the secondary timeframe must be checked on each new bar. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP/Trail by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated. The CMoney conditional sizing (negative=fixed, positive=percent) needs explicit branching in Python. Use pandas for multi-timeframe resampling to align the secondary timeframe signal with the primary.
